card.name: Words before a physical device or tool
card.fires_on: Words just before a mechanical object or tool is named, such as a modifier or article after a verb of using or making. Examples are 'rented' before cycle van, 'splitting' before device, and 'the' before a hand-cranked churn.

modes.label: Modifier before a device
modes.description: An adjective or verb form describing a physical device, right before the device noun.
modes.example: Seven months ago, Kamrul used to carry the stuff of other people on his<< rented>> cycle van.

modes.label: Article before equipment
modes.description: A small word such as the or a, before a piece of equipment or mechanism is named.
modes.example: In 1843, New England housewife Nancy Johnson invented<< the>> hand-cranked ice cream churn.

modes.label: Partway through a device term
modes.description: Inside a word or phrase naming a tool, such as a pipette or a hand crank.
modes.example: repeat the above instructions for your other eye using a new<< pip>>ette.

card.writes: It pushes against odd non-English and code tokens and slightly favors the word attachment(s), so it hints at an upcoming attached object or accessory.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a gadget or tool is named, such as a splitting device or a rented van.
